metric: PyPI Stats last_month downloads excluding known mirrors
note: The 'mp3' (123 hits) and 'mpeg' (201 hits) name queries are recorded in the snapshot but were not individually triaged beyond the packages listed here; the candidate list follows the packages with documented local MP3 APIs in data/python/mp3_id3v2.

leads.name: av
leads.reason: PyAV binds FFmpeg's libavformat/libavcodec; Layer III frames are parsed in native FFmpeg code, so Python source line coverage would not reach the parser. Same FFmpeg family as the mp3_id3v2/python av entry. Not run on the untagged controls.

leads.name: soundfile
leads.reason: CFFI binding to libsndfile, which decodes MP3 through libmpg123 (the mp3/c selected family). Parser code is native. Not run.

leads.name: pydub
leads.reason: AudioSegment.from_mp3 shells out to an external ffmpeg/avconv binary; no in-package frame parser.

leads.name: librosa
leads.reason: librosa.load decodes through soundfile/libsndfile or audioread; no own frame parser.

leads.name: mutagen
leads.reason: Selected and verified: mutagen.mp3.MPEGInfo parses Layer III frame headers of the untagged controls in pure Python; see data/python/mp3/parsers.json.

leads.name: audioread
leads.reason: Dispatches to FFmpeg, GStreamer or Core Audio backends; no own frame parser. Not run.

leads.name: tinytag
leads.reason: Pure-Python reader that parses MPEG frame headers for duration, bitrate and sample rate in tinytag/tinytag.py; independent of Mutagen. Its public API is TinyTag.get(filename=..., file_obj=...). Not run in this one-entry pilot.

leads.name: pygame
leads.reason: pygame.mixer decodes MP3 through SDL_mixer's bundled native decoder; requires an audio device or dummy driver. Not run.

leads.name: pymediainfo
leads.reason: Wrapper for the native MediaInfoLib library. Not run.

leads.name: miniaudio
leads.reason: CFFI binding to miniaudio with the dr_mp3 C decoder. Not run.

leads.name: hachoir
leads.reason: Pure-Python parser framework with an MPEG audio parser module; frame-level output API not checked. Not run.

leads.name: eyed3
leads.reason: Pure-Python ID3 toolkit with an MP3 frame header and Xing reader in eyed3.mp3.headers. Not run.

leads.name: pymp3
leads.reason: PyPI summary 'Read and write MP3 files'; frame-header API not checked. Not run.
